en.name: Gynecomastia (Male Breast Reduction)
en.meta_title: Gynecomastia Surgery: Male Breast Reduction for a Firmer Chest
en.meta_description: Correct overdeveloped male breast tissue (gynecomastia) with male breast reduction surgery. This procedure removes excess fat and glandular tissue to restore a flatter, firmer, and more masculine chest contour.
en.meta_keywords: gynecomastia, male breast reduction, man boobs surgery, gynecomastia surgery, chest contouring for men, plastic surgery

what_is.heading: What is Gynecomastia?
paragraphs: Gynecomastia is a common condition characterized by the overdevelopment of breast tissue in men, resulting in the appearance of "male breasts." It can be caused by hormonal imbalances, genetics, or certain medications and can be a significant source of self-consciousness. Male breast reduction surgery is a highly effective procedure to correct this issue.

procedure.heading: The Male Breast Reduction Procedure
paragraphs: The surgery aims to restore a flatter, firmer, and more masculine chest contour. The specific technique used depends on the cause of the gynecomastia. If it is primarily due to excess fatty tissue, liposuction alone may be sufficient. If excess glandular tissue is the cause, this tissue will be surgically excised through a small incision around the areola. In many cases, a combination of both techniques is used.

results_recovery.heading: Permanent Results and Recovery
paragraphs: Recovery is relatively quick, with most men returning to work within a week. The results are permanent and can have a profound impact on self-esteem, allowing men to feel comfortable and confident going shirtless or wearing fitted clothing.
